answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 13407 Country: India Title: If in fasting condition any one embress wife and madhiy (not mani) is it breaks fast? Question: If in fasting condition any one embress wife and madhiy (not mani) is it breaks fast? Answer ID: 13407 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 902/902=M/1430) If semen is not discharged, the sawm (fast) will not break, but it is makrooh to embrace wife if one fears ejaculation: کما في الدر: وکرہ قبلۃ ومس ومعانقۃ ومباشرۃ فاحشۃ إن لم یأمن المفسد وإن أمن لا بأس Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
